d:
Bihar men sattarurh rashtriy jantantrik gathbandhan (NDA) ke ghatak dalon—bijepi aur jadyu ke bich kathit tanatni ki charchaon ke bich siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. kangres netaon ke bad ab rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke varishth vidhayak bhaee virendr ne bihar ki rajniti men sanbhavit badlavon ko lekar bara bayan diya hai.
"nitish do bar sath aa chuke hain, rajniti sanbhavnaon ka khel"
